To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the meta-optimization of the genetic algorithm parameters is feasible and the meta-optimized algorithm performs better than the base-level algorithm.

the metaoptimization of the genetic algorithm parameters for different base-level problems can improve the performance of the genetic algorithm and that this improvement is more significant for harder problems.

parameter optimization of metaheuristic algorithms can be automated by applying another metaheuristic algorithm on the meta-level, that the quality of the parameter settings can be improved and the effort to find the optimal parameter values can be reduced by using this method.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a general approach to automate the optimization of parameter values of heuristic optimization algorithms.
the automation of parameter optimization for heuristic optimization algorithms.
the automation of the parameter tuning of heuristic optimization algorithms by using another optimization on the meta-level.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the meta-optimization is able to find good parameter values for a genetic algorithm, but it is not able to improve the performance significantly.
the parameter optimization of a metaheuristic algorithm is possible and that the quality of the results depends on the base-level problem.
the meta-optimization is not able to outperform the best base-level optimization results.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
meta-optimization is a powerful technique to find optimal parameter values.
meta-optimization is an effective tool for the parameter optimization of metaheuristic algorithms.
the optimization of parameters of a metaheuristic optimization algorithm is feasible and the meta-level approach is a promising approach.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the meta-level optimization of the parameter values of a heuristic optimization algorithms is possible and that the quality of the results of this meta-optimization can be improved significantly by using problem specific knowledge.
meta-optimization of algorithms is possible, but the performance of meta-optimized algorithms is not always superior to the performance of algorithms which are manually tuned.
parameter optimization is not only a tedious task, but also a time consuming one.
